simple.meaning: סַנְוֵר (çanvêr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “(in plural) blindness.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 19:11. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סַנְוֵר (H5575) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: סַנְוֵר (çanvêr) / H5575 is traced through Genesis 19:11, 2 Kings 6:18 with generated occurrence evidence.
